title: Muk May Need Pollution to Survive

direction.premise: Muk's survival may depend on the dirty environments people worked to clean up.
direction.audiencePromise: Reveal why cleaner environments made Muk rare, then show the strange solution being built to save it.
direction.openLoop: How could environmental progress push Muk toward extinction?
direction.payoff: Muk may need sludge ponds to survive, even as its germs have led to extermination efforts.
direction.engagementQuestion: Save Muk with sludge ponds, or choose cleaner habitats?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and slightly incredulous. Stress the contradiction in cleanup and survival. Use crisp pauses before each reveal, then land the final choice clearly.

scenes.headline: CLEANUP PUTS MUK AT RISK
scenes.narration: Muk needs sludge ponds—cleaner environments may erase it.
scenes.caption: CLEANER WORLD. FEWER MUK.

scenes.headline: DIRTY AREAS ATTRACT MUK
scenes.narration: Muk gathers where sludge accumulates, making the stench even worse.
scenes.caption: SLUDGE BUILDS. MUK FOLLOWS.

scenes.headline: ENVIRONMENTAL PROGRESS HURTS MUK
scenes.narration: Environmental improvements cut its food sources, leaving Muk hardly seen.
scenes.caption: FEWER SOURCES. FEWER MUK.

scenes.headline: SLUDGE PONDS TO THE RESCUE
scenes.narration: Now, purpose-built sludge ponds are being built to prevent its extinction.
scenes.caption: POLLUTION BECOMES PROTECTION

scenes.headline: MUK WAS TARGETED FOR EXTERMINATION
scenes.narration: But Muk scatters germs, and people have targeted it for extermination.
scenes.caption: SAVING IT ISN'T SIMPLE

scenes.headline: WHAT SHOULD SURVIVE?
scenes.narration: Save Muk with sludge ponds, or choose cleaner habitats?
scenes.caption: PROTECT MUK OR PROTECT CLEANUP?
